prompt: This is a raw interview clip with Ann Matsuuchi from WikiConference North America 2025. There's a lot of dead air between her sentences. Can you tighten that up so it flows, then caption the whole thing? Please don't clip any of her words.

checklist.description: The clip got shorter than the 151 s source, but not so short that speech must have gone
The cuts were closed up: picture runs continuously from 0 with no black holes
Every picture segment still has its own sound at the same place
A caption track exists with a real number of cues
Captions run through the clip, not just part of it
No caption sits over a gap or past the end (stale cues from before the cut)
No word is cut off at any edit
Caption text matches what she says, her name spelled right if it appears
